import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_DIM = 20;
    static final int MAX_NODES = 400;
    static final int MAX_EDGES = 200000;
    static final int INF_DIST = 199999999;

    static int[][] board = new int[MAX_DIM][MAX_DIM];
    static int[] bfs_dist = new int[MAX_NODES];
    static int[] queue_arr = new int[MAX_NODES];
    static int[] in_q = new int[MAX_NODES];
    static int[][] dist_all = new int[MAX_NODES][MAX_NODES];
    static int grid_size, total_nodes, time_cap;
    static String input_row;
    static int zero_pos_r, zero_pos_c;
    static int[] dir_r = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static int[] dir_c = {-1, 1, 0, 0};

    static class Edge {
        int u, v, f, next;
        Edge(int u, int v, int f, int next) {
            this.u = u;
            this.v = v;
            this.f = f;
            this.next = next;
        }
    }

    static Edge[] graph_edges = new Edge[MAX_EDGES];
    static int[] edge_front = new int[MAX_NODES];
    static int num_edges;
    static int source_vertex, sink_vertex;
    static List<Integer> supply_coords = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<Integer> demand_coords = new ArrayList<>();

    static int node_id(int r, int c) {
        return (r-1)*grid_size + c;
    }

    static boolean in_bounds(int r, int c) {
        return r >= 1 && r <= grid_size && c >= 1 && c <= grid_size && board[r][c] != -1;
    }

    static void build_adj_matrix() {
        total_nodes = grid_size * grid_size;
        for (int i = 1; i <= total_nodes; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= total_nodes; j++) {
                dist_all[i][j] = -1;
            }
        }
        for (int r = 1; r <= grid_size; r++) {
            for (int c = 1; c <= grid_size; c++) {
                if (board[r][c] == -1) continue;
                int u = node_id(r, c);
                dist_all[u][u] = 0;
                for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                    int nr = r + dir_r[k];
                    int nc = c + dir_c[k];
                    if (in_bounds(nr, nc)) {
                        int v = node_id(nr, nc);
                        dist_all[u][v] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void single_source_shortest_paths() {
        for (int i = 1; i <= total_nodes; ++i) bfs_dist[i] = INF_DIST;
        int fr = 0, rr = 0;
        int start = node_id(zero_pos_r, zero_pos_c);
        bfs_dist[start] = 0;
        queue_arr[rr++] = start;
        while (fr < rr) {
            int cur = queue_arr[fr++];
            for (int nxt = 1; nxt <= total_nodes; ++nxt) {
                if (dist_all[cur][nxt] == 1 && bfs_dist[nxt] > bfs_dist[cur] + 1) {
                    bfs_dist[nxt] = bfs_dist[cur] + 1;
                    queue_arr[rr++] = nxt;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void all_pairs_paths() {
        for (int k = 1; k <= total_nodes; ++k) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= total_nodes; ++i) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= total_nodes; ++j) {
                    if (dist_all[i][k] != -1 && dist_all[k][j] != -1) {
                        if (dist_all[i][j] == -1 || dist_all[i][j] > dist_all[i][k] + dist_all[k][j]) {
                            dist_all[i][j] = dist_all[i][k] + dist_all[k][j];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void setup_flow_network() {
        Arrays.fill(edge_front, -1);
        num_edges = 0;
        source_vertex = 0;
        sink_vertex = supply_coords.size() / 3 + demand_coords.size() / 3 + 1;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < supply_coords.size(); i += 3) {
            int cnt = supply_coords.get(i+2);
            graph_edges[num_edges] = new Edge(source_vertex, (int)(i/3)+1, cnt, edge_front[source_vertex]);
            edge_front[source_vertex] = num_edges++;
            graph_edges[num_edges] = new Edge((int)(i/3)+1, source_vertex, 0, edge_front[(int)(i/3)+1]);
            edge_front[(int)(i/3)+1] = num_edges++;
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < demand_coords.size(); i += 3) {
            int cnt = demand_coords.get(i+2);
            graph_edges[num_edges] = new Edge((int)(supply_coords.size()/3) + (int)(i/3)+1, sink_vertex, cnt, edge_front[(int)(supply_coords.size()/3) + (int)(i/3)+1]);
            edge_front[(int)(supply_coords.size()/3) + (int)(i/3)+1] = num_edges++;
            graph_edges[num_edges] = new Edge(sink_vertex, (int)(supply_coords.size()/3) + (int)(i/3)+1, 0, edge_front[sink_vertex]);
            edge_front[sink_vertex] = num_edges++;
        }
        
        int source_node_id = node_id(zero_pos_r, zero_pos_c);
        for (int i = 0; i < supply_coords.size(); i += 3) {
            int sr = supply_coords.get(i), sc = supply_coords.get(i+1);
            int sp = node_id(sr, sc);
            for (int j = 0; j < demand_coords.size(); j += 3) {
                int dr = demand_coords.get(j), dc = demand_coords.get(j+1);
                int dp = node_id(dr, dc);
                if (dist_all[sp][dp] != -1 && dist_all[sp][dp] <= time_cap) {
                    if (dist_all[sp][dp] < bfs_dist[dp]) {
                        graph_edges[num_edges] = new Edge((int)(i/3)+1, (int)(supply_coords.size()/3) + (int)(j/3)+1, INF_DIST, edge_front[(int)(i/3)+1]);
                        edge_front[(int)(i/3)+1] = num_edges++;
                        graph_edges[num_edges] = new Edge((int)(supply_coords.size()/3) + (int)(j/3)+1, (int)(i/3)+1, 0, edge_front[(int)(supply_coords.size()/3) + (int)(j/3)+1]);
                        edge_front[(int)(supply_coords.size()/3) + (int)(j/3)+1] = num_edges++;
                    } else if (dist_all[sp][dp] == bfs_dist[dp]) {
                        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                            int nr = dr + dir_r[d], nc = dc + dir_c[d];
                            if (in_bounds(nr, nc)) {
                                int np = node_id(nr, nc);
                                if (dist_all[sp][np] == dist_all[sp][dp] - 1 && dist_all[sp][np] < bfs_dist[np]) {
                                    graph_edges[num_edges] = new Edge((int)(i/3)+1, (int)(supply_coords.size()/3) + (int)(j/3)+1, INF_DIST, edge_front[(int)(i/3)+1]);
                                    edge_front[(int)(i/3)+1] = num_edges++;
                                    graph_edges[num_edges] = new Edge((int)(supply_coords.size()/3) + (int)(j/3)+1, (int)(i/3)+1, 0, edge_front[(int)(supply_coords.size()/3) + (int)(j/3)+1]);
                                    edge_front[(int)(supply_coords.size()/3) + (int)(j/3)+1] = num_edges++;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int[] node_level = new int[MAX_NODES];
    static int[] bfs_queue = new int[MAX_NODES];

    static boolean level_graph_bfs() {
        Arrays.fill(node_level, -1);
        int f = 0, r = 0;
        bfs_queue[r++] = source_vertex;
        node_level[source_vertex] = 0;
        while (f < r) {
            int u = bfs_queue[f++];
            for (int e = edge_front[u]; ~e != 0; e = graph_edges[e].next) {
                int v = graph_edges[e].v;
                if (node_level[v] == -1 && graph_edges[e].f > 0) {
                    node_level[v] = node_level[u] + 1;
                    if (v == sink_vertex) return true;
                    bfs_queue[r++] = v;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static int[] stack_path = new int[MAX_NODES];
    static int[] curr_edge = new int[MAX_NODES];

    static int dinic_dfs(int u, int min_flow) {
        if (u == sink_vertex) return min_flow;
        for (int i = curr_edge[u]; ~i != 0; i = graph_edges[i].next) {
            int v = graph_edges[i].v;
            if (node_level[v] == node_level[u] + 1 && graph_edges[i].f > 0) {
                int pushed = dinic_dfs(v, Math.min(min_flow, graph_edges[i].f));
                if (pushed > 0) {
                    graph_edges[i].f -= pushed;
                    graph_edges[i^1].f += pushed;
                    return pushed;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int compute_max_flow() {
        int total = 0;
        while (level_graph_bfs()) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= sink_vertex; ++i) curr_edge[i] = edge_front[i];
            while (true) {
                int pushed = dinic_dfs(source_vertex, INF_DIST);
                if (pushed <= 0) break;
                total += pushed;
            }
        }
        return total;
    }

    static int main_solution() {
        board[zero_pos_r][zero_pos_c] = 0;
        build_adj_matrix();
        single_source_shortest_paths();
        board[zero_pos_r][zero_pos_c] = -1;
        build_adj_matrix();
        all_pairs_paths();
        setup_flow_network();
        return compute_max_flow();
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        grid_size = sc.nextInt();
        time_cap = sc.nextInt();
        supply_coords.clear();
        demand_coords.clear();
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_DIM; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(board[i], 0);
        }
        
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline
        for (int i = 1; i <= grid_size; ++i) {
            input_row = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < grid_size; ++j) {
                if (input_row.charAt(j) == 'Y') board[i][j+1] = -1;
                else if (input_row.charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    zero_pos_r = i; zero_pos_c = j+1;
                    board[i][j+1] = -1;
                }
                else if (input_row.charAt(j) > '0' && input_row.charAt(j) <= '9') {
                    supply_coords.add(i);
                    supply_coords.add(j+1);
                    supply_coords.add(input_row.charAt(j)-'0');
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= grid_size; ++i) {
            input_row = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < grid_size; ++j) {
                if (input_row.charAt(j) > '0' && input_row.charAt(j) <= '9') {
                    demand_coords.add(i);
                    demand_coords.add(j+1);
                    demand_coords.add(input_row.charAt(j)-'0');
                }
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(main_solution());
    }
}
